description: Remove an entry for real: mode 'compact' (saveCompact) rewrites the archive without the dead bytes — still no recompression of the surviving entries, entries keep their order — so the removed payload is truly gone (an SFX prefix would be dropped too). summary.entryCountBefore / entryCountAfter and grewByBytes show the effect; includeSha256 proves the result. Add canonical: {} for the canonical deterministic form (modify-compact-canonical.json).
